newsitem.title: UK: European Commission to promote milk as "modern".
newsitem.headline: European Commission to promote milk as "modern".

text.p: Forget about drinking milk because your mother told you it was good for you. The European Commission wants to encourage young people to choose milk because it's "modern" and nutritious.
The European Commission on Wednesday said it plans to promote milk consumption by young people with a campaign designed to create a modern image for it.
The European Commission, in a statement issued in Brussels, said it had adopted 16 programmes at a total cost of 8.75 million ECUs ($10 million) to promote milk in the 15-nation EU.
The promotional efforts, which will be aimed at people under 25, will focus on "a modern image for milk" and on nutrition, the commission said.
"The idea is that milk should no longer be something they are given to drink but a drink chosen by this age group," the commission said in the statement.

The promotional efforts will include public relations, including events such as The Week of Milk and Health and The Milk Party; sports sponsorship, nutritional information, and traditional media, the EC said.

The EC, which adopted 16 programmes out of 28 proposed by member nations, said milk and milk products would be promoted as "perfectly adapted to current consumer trends while remaining pure and natural."
